patthana21.44:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ,
patthana21.44:2.1: na lokuttaraṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo sanidassana sappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetu paccayā. ekaṃ,
patthana21.44:4.1: na lokiyaṃ na anidassana sappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo anidassana sappaṭigho-. tīṇi, (tīṇimeva pañhā kātabbā.) na lokuttaraṃ ka anidassana appaṭighaṃ
patthana21.44:5.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca lokiyo anidassana appaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā hetuyā ekaṃ. na kenaciviññeyyaṃ na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ
